task.name: Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling
task.description: Write a Python dispatch(ready_operations, time) rule that picks which ready operation to start next and, optionally, which eligible machine runs it in an event-driven flexible job-shop simulation; scored by mean makespan on five generated instances with 10 jobs and 5 machines (lower is better).
task.contract: dispatch(ready_operations, time) -> index of the ready operation to start (optionally (index, machine)); each ready operation is a dict with job, op, machine_options {machine: duration}, remaining_ops, remaining_work. Score: mean makespan
